Here Comes the Regulation: A Judge Is Being Asked to Freeze AI at Today's Level.

Mech: Four nonprofits sued OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta and SpaceX in San Francisco on Wednesday. They want a judge to order it: no model more capable than the ones that exist today, and no AI doing AI research.
